authorNote: M1 sample drafted by Claude Code, 2026-10-09; format and content reviewed by Steve Grant, 2026-10-10. Unpublished until the habit's full set is written (M2). The four levels and anchors are the heart of Station C; they should be Steve’s.
title: Is the student steering their own thinking?
focus: How far a student’s own talk or writing, after you’ve modelled, shows them deciding, checking and repairing — not just producing an answer.

levels.name: Answer only
levels.descriptor: Gives the result with no visible process.

levels.name: Steps narrated
levels.descriptor: Describes the steps in order, but not why. The actions are there; the decisions aren’t.
levels.anchor: “First I did the carbons, then the hydrogens, then the oxygens.”

levels.name: Decisions explained
levels.descriptor: Explains why a step was chosen, or names the strategy being used.
levels.anchor: “I left oxygen till last because it’s in both products.”

levels.name: Monitoring and repair
levels.descriptor: Notices a problem or checks a result, says how they knew, and what they changed.
levels.anchor: “My oxygens came to 7, and you can’t have half an O<sub>2</sub>, so I doubled everything and counted again.”
